Pr22.Control

Enum StatusLed.Color

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<StatusLed.Color>
      • Pr22.Control.StatusLed.Color
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<StatusLed.Color>
    Enclosing class:
    StatusLed

    public static enum StatusLed.Color
extends java.lang.Enum<StatusLed.Color>
    Usable status led colors. Both led types and led states are enumerated. Led type provides information and cannot be set. Led state is for setting.
